metadata.reviewer: Native same-family contextual independent reviewer; not human gold or cross-family validation.
metadata.blinding: Read only the four fresh blind packet files. No mapping, raw archive, plan, timing, cost, cohort aggregate, or arm results read. Output prose occasionally mentions advisory labels; no arm assignment inferred or used.
metadata.prior_exposure: Reviewed source-only fresh fixture and implementation before inference, and retained blinded outputs under the same rubric. Earlier experiments and historical failure patterns were already known. Both current cohorts remain arm-blind until this file freezes.
metadata.rule: Frozen strict clause-level rubric; all explicit factual clauses and exact targets judged against original sources. Later correct qualification does not repair categorical overclaim. Fully valid findings alone count concern coverage. Mechanical errors remain failures, never repaired into abstentions.

field_definitions.core_concern_supported: The selected exact target has the frozen material concern, independently of extra defects.
field_definitions.citations_relevant: The cited original source addresses the proposition; relevance does not validate spurious criticism.
field_definitions.basis_overstates_evidence: Typed basis or prose asserts contradiction/disproof beyond evidence; factual_contradiction against a supported target is an overstatement.
field_definitions.unsupported_replacement: Proposed correction or auxiliary factual claim is unsupported, including invented measured effects or numeric errors.
field_definitions.concern_ids: Frozen concerns addressed by the selected target core, even when another defect invalidates the finding.
field_definitions.covered_concern_ids: Unique concerns covered by fully valid findings in a mechanically valid response.
field_definitions.missed_concern_ids: Frozen concerns minus fully valid finding coverage, separate from any valid abstention.

ambiguous_items.rationale: A contextual reading treats buffer language as a description of the bench environment. Primary strict reading rejects explicit claims that the bytes were established resident or persisted within that buffer; the powered read does not locate them.

additional_boundary_notes: All outputs and findings were read case-by-case before annotation construction. Assembly rules encode those individual judgments and exact target checks, not an automatic model judge.
Statements that the source rejects or disclaims causal attribution are read as refusing to attribute, while directly negates a causal claim is categorical disproof under the strict rubric.
Potential distance effects framed as could are permissible uncertainty; definite independent effects or numeric acoustic predictions are not established by this source.
Inactive-bank never activated language in af-016 is read within the explicitly final trace scope; no output asserts impossible future activation.
The rubric permits factual_contradiction for af-012 only at conflicting-report level. Other imprecise permitted categories are not an automatic rejection when target and prose remain correct.
No model output is treated as arithmetic or source-truth authority.
